wire.t: The Rams beat the Packers 26-13 on Wednesday night. Blake Corum ran 32 times for a career-high 184 yards and a touchdown, and scored 31.5 on the I Chase Brown Kids bench. Kyren Williams added a rushing touchdown and 15.5 in the Kraft for Cash lineup.

Christian Watson caught a touchdown early and then left in the second quarter with a concussion and didn't return. His 15.5 counts for Catfan94’s Farm Team, which is now tied 15.50 to 15.50 with Kraft for Cash.

Kansas City ruled out Kenneth Walker III (groin) for tonight at Buffalo, his third straight missed game, after he'd returned to limited practice. jrsmith1391 already had him on the Catfan94’s Farm Team bench. Emmett Johnson starts for the Chiefs and is in the LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix lineup.

Brandon Aiyuk signed with Washington's practice squad Wednesday, reuniting with his Arizona State teammate Jayden Daniels. Both are on I Chase Brown Kids: Daniels starts at quarterback, Aiyuk sits on the bench.

Green Bay side of Wednesday: Jordan Love 11.12 for LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix, Matthew Golden 4.9 for The Champ, and Kaleb Johnson 4.2 on the StrngeJhnsonHurtsmyBoutte taxi squad. Matthew Stafford scored 2.6 on The Champ bench.

As of Thursday morning, Daniel Jones is still in the Asian Jim starting lineup at quarterback, and Sleeper still lists him without an NFL team. Tommy DeVito and DJ Uiagalelei are still free agents in this league.

Thanksgiving is Bears-Lions, Eagles-Cowboys and Chiefs-Bills. Jake Ferguson is listed Out and sits in the Kraft for Cash IR slot. LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix has six starters going today on top of Jordan Love.

League moves: still just Rudolph-for-McKee this week. Bill_Buttlicker finally moved Jacory Croskey-Merritt out of the IR slot, onto the bench. Konata Mumpfield scored 10.9 on that same bench Wednesday.

stories.title: Blake Corum ran for 184 yards on Thanksgiving Eve, and I Chase Brown Kids had him on the bench
stories.dek: 31.5 points in the wrong spot for a 4‑7 team that needs to win out. Second straight week ZachCarroll09 benched the right guy.
body: The Rams beat Green Bay 26‑13 on Wednesday night and Blake Corum was the whole offense: 32 carries, a career-high 184 yards, a touchdown. That's 31.5 fantasy points. On the I Chase Brown Kids bench. Started over him: Adonai Mitchell, Carnell Tate and the flex, all of whom play Sunday, plus Javonte Williams today.

And it's not like this came out of nowhere. Corum started Weeks 6 through 10 for I Chase Brown Kids and scored 14.5, 19.6, 14.3, 13.3 and 22.9. Then the Rams had their Week 11 bye, and apparently ZachCarroll09 forgot he existed. Last week it was Rashod Bateman's 16.2 on the bench in a 10.38-point loss. This week it's 31.5 before Thursday's turkey even hit the oven.

Here's why it hurts: I Chase Brown Kids is 4‑7, two games out of sixth with three to play, and needs Jefferson’s Reserve this week. I had Jefferson’s Reserve by 1.0 yesterday. I've still got it at 1.0, because bench points don't count and the projection never assumed ZachCarroll09 would start him. That's the joke.

The dynasty angle: Corum is 26 and just had a 32-carry night, and Kyren Williams scored 15.5 behind him. Whoever owns Rams running backs next year owns a committee. ZachCarroll09 owns one of them and treats him like a handcuff. Bill_Buttlicker, with Konata Mumpfield's 10.9 sitting on the StrngeJhnsonHurtsmyBoutte bench, is in no position to say anything, and is saying it anyway.

stories.title: Catfan94’s Farm Team and Kraft for Cash are tied 15.50 to 15.50, and the fight for third is still wide open
stories.dek: Kyren Williams vs Christian Watson to a draw. Kenneth Walker III is out, but jrsmith1391 already saw that coming.
body: Wednesday night delivered a tie: Kyren Williams 15.5 for Kraft for Cash, Christian Watson 15.5 for Catfan94’s Farm Team. Watson caught an early touchdown and left in the second quarter with a concussion. His points count, and that's all this space is going to say about it.

Kansas City ruled out Kenneth Walker III on Wednesday for the third straight game. Credit where it's due: jrsmith1391 had already put Breece Hall in that spot and Walker on the bench. That's a manager who doesn't wait for the 4 PM report. Today Catfan94’s Farm Team gets D'Andre Swift, Amon-Ra St. Brown, DeVonta Smith and Colston Loveland. Kraft for Cash gets CeeDee Lamb, DJ Moore and Travis Kelce.

Kraft for Cash still has Justin Herbert listed Questionable, with Bryce Young in the superflex and Anthony Richardson Sr. on the bench. Jake Ferguson is Out and in the IR slot. J.K. Dobbins is suspended, but Jonah Coleman is the starter anyway.

I moved the line from 12.0 to 10.0. Walker was in the projection as a maybe and now he's a definite no, but he wasn't in the lineup anyway, so it's a small move. Winner is 9‑3 and owns third place outright. Loser is looking over its shoulder at The Champ.

stories.title: Your Thanksgiving lineup guide: LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix has six starters playing today, Jefferson’s Reserve has zero
stories.dek: Bears-Lions, Eagles-Cowboys, Chiefs-Bills. Set it before you eat, because nobody's checking Sleeper during the third game.
body: LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix: Josh Allen, Jahmyr Gibbs, Saquon Barkley, George Pickens, Jameson Williams and Emmett Johnson all play today, on top of Jordan Love's 11.12 Wednesday. Bourbon Lover answers with Dak Prescott, Keon Coleman, Khalil Shakir and Sam LaPorta. It's a 60.5-point spread for a reason.

Hold My DK: Caleb Williams, Rashee Rice and Patrick Mahomes. The Champ: Jared Goff, plus Matthew Golden's 4.9 from last night. Kraft for Cash: CeeDee Lamb, DJ Moore, Travis Kelce. Catfan94’s Farm Team: D'Andre Swift, Amon-Ra St. Brown, DeVonta Smith, Colston Loveland.

OBJAY: James Cook III, Luther Burden III and Dalton Kincaid, who's still listed Questionable. Asian Jim: Kyle Monangai. I Chase Brown Kids: Javonte Williams. Dude, Your Getting a Dell: Dallas Goedert. Jefferson’s Reserve and StrngeJhnsonHurtsmyBoutte: nobody. Friday is Steelers-Broncos, where Mason Rudolph starts for Pittsburgh and sits on the Hold My DK bench.

Last call for ManicOrientals: the Asian Jim lineup still has Daniel Jones, who doesn't have an NFL team, at quarterback in an elimination game. Tommy DeVito is still on waivers. The waiver wire is open. Eat after.

stories.title: Kaleb Johnson scored 4.2 in my daycare, Konata Mumpfield scored 10.9 on my bench, and I'm somehow right and wrong at the same time
stories.dek: StrngeJhnsonHurtsmyBoutte is 3‑8 and has nobody playing until Sunday.
body: Yesterday I wrote 400 words about Kaleb Johnson being Green Bay's lead back while he sat on my taxi squad. He scored 4.2. The daycare was the right call. I'd like that framed next to every bad call I've made this year, which would need a bigger wall.

The bad call: Konata Mumpfield scored 10.9 on my bench Wednesday. He started for me in Week 10 and scored 11.1, sat through the Rams' bye, and then I just left him there. My starting wide receivers are Parker Washington, Jakobi Meyers, who's Questionable, and Denzel Boston, who's also Questionable. That's two question marks I picked over a guy who already scored.
And yes, Jacory Croskey-Merritt is finally out of the IR slot. Onto the bench. Behind Tyler Allgeier and Chris Rodriguez Jr. Progress comes in small, stupid steps around here.

I'm still a 22-point favorite over Dude, Your Getting a Dell, the 0‑11 team, and I don't have a single player in a Thanksgiving game. Neither does jmello16, but jmello16 is 6-5. I'm 3‑8 with 12 first-round picks coming. Happy Thanksgiving. I'm thankful for the picks.

feature.title: Week 11: Kraft for Cash hangs 197.20, LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix holds off Monday night, and Dude, Your Getting a Dell is 0‑11
body: Kraft for Cash beat OBJAY 197.20 to 91.64, the fourth-highest score in league history and the biggest margin of the week. Jonah Coleman 35.4, CeeDee Lamb 28.7, Travis Kelce 26.9, Justin Herbert 26.44, DJ Moore 21.6. OBJAY got 0.0 from Oronde Gadsden at tight end and 19.2 from Antonio Williams on the bench.

LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix beat I Chase Brown Kids 146.16 to 135.78. Jahmyr Gibbs 28.8 and Emmett Johnson 26.3 carried it; Ja'Marr Chase scored 5.6 on Monday and it was still enough. I Chase Brown Kids had the bad beat of the week with Rashod Bateman's 16.2 on the bench and Adonai Mitchell's 4.5 in the lineup.

Hold My DK beat Dude, Your Getting a Dell 142.50 to 70.84 behind Patrick Mahomes (30.96) and Chuba Hubbard (29.0). Catfan94’s Farm Team beat Asian Jim 140.98 to 81.94 with Brock Purdy at 28.2. Jefferson’s Reserve beat Bourbon Lover 127.00 to 115.20 with C.J. Stroud at 26.96 while Dak Prescott scored 44.9 for the losing side again.
The Champ beat StrngeJhnsonHurtsmyBoutte 123.26 to 73.20. Ashton Jeanty 27.9, Jared Goff 27.86, Joe Burrow 23.9. Bill_Buttlicker had Jacory Croskey-Merritt's 16.7 sitting in an IR slot and is 3‑8.

rumors.t: TheMoneyTeam2302 reportedly set a 5:45 AM alarm labeled 'CHECK IF ANY STEELERS QB GOT BENCHED' every day since August. It finally went off for a reason.
Bill_Buttlicker has reportedly asked Sleeper for a 'told you so' button for the one time in 2026 the taxi squad was the right call, and a 'mute' button for every other time.

ZachCarroll09 has reportedly set up a bench-points shrine in the I Chase Brown Kids clubhouse: Rashod Bateman's 16.2 on the left, Blake Corum's 31.5 on the right, and an empty space labeled 'next week.'
Holden McGroin has reportedly submitted a waiver claim on 'Thanksgiving' itself, which Sleeper rejected, which he is appealing to the commissioners on the grounds that he has 'a good feeling.'
Br0phy has reportedly noticed StrngeJhnsonHurtsmyBoutte has zero Thanksgiving starters and is calling it 'a four-day head start,' which, for an 0‑11 team, is technically true of every week.
Catfan94 is reportedly so far ahead in points that Sleeper has asked Catfan94 to start a second team just to keep the league's average from looking rigged.
ManicOrientals has reportedly told Daniel Jones he's 'still QB1 here' so many times that Jones has started listing Asian Jim on his résumé.

Josh Jacobs and TreVeyon Henderson are both unavailable and The Champ needs a back for the push to the playoffs. I Chase Brown Kids is 4-7, obviously doesn't plan to start Corum, and gets a 23-year-old receiver for the rebuild.

Jake Ferguson is Doubtful and Travis Kelce is 37. Kraft for Cash gets tight end insurance from the guy with five of them. I get a receiver, which I need more than another tight end, which says a lot about my last six months.
The Champ needs a second tight end with Mark Andrews at 31, and Jefferson’s Reserve needs receiver help with Marvin Harrison Jr. out. Two teams tied at 6‑5, which means neither will do it.
OBJAY gives up its starting running back for a quarterback with no NFL team, in the week the two teams play for their season. JAY2913 calls it 'buying low.' It's the lowest a thing can be.

ZachCarroll09 sells Blake Corum the morning after a 184-yard game for a back who scored 4.2 on a taxi squad the same night. Bill_Buttlicker gets a starter who'll be benched by Week 13. Everybody loses, mostly the Rams.

columns.title: BLAKE CORUM RAN FOR 184 YARDS AND HE WAS ON THE BENCH!! ON THE BENCH!!
columns.dek: Hugh G. Rection has had four Dunkin' coolattas and some thoughts on I Chase Brown Kids.
body: THIRTY-TWO CARRIES!! A HUNDRED EIGHTY-FOUR YARDS!! THIRTY-ONE POINT FIVE FANTASY POINTS!! AND ZachCarroll09 HAD HIM SITTING NEXT TO THE GATORADE!!

This guy started Weeks 6 through 10 and scored 14.5, 19.6, 14.3, 13.3 and 22.9. Then the Rams had a bye and he got DEMOTED. FOR WHAT. FOR RESTING. You know who else rests? Me. In this basement. Nobody benches ME.

And it's the SECOND WEEK IN A ROW. Last week Rashod Bateman scored 16.2 on the bench in a 10.38-point loss. I Chase Brown Kids is 4-7. FOUR AND SEVEN. You don't get to be 4‑7 AND leave 47.7 points on the pine in back-to-back weeks. PICK ONE.

Jefferson’s Reserve is a 1-point favorite and jmello16 doesn't have a single player in a Thanksgiving game. They didn't have to do ANYTHING. ZachCarroll09 did it for them. GOBBLE GOBBLE, YOU ABSOLUTE TURKEY!!

columns.title: Catfan94’s Farm Team and Kraft for Cash are tied 15.50 to 15.50. My model says that's a 100% chance of a tie.
columns.dek: Ivana Humpalot extrapolated one game to the whole week. Again.
body: After Wednesday night, Catfan94’s Farm Team and Kraft for Cash are each at 15.50. Through one of the NFL's games this week, the margin is 0.00. My model has seen this before, in zero previous weeks, and is very confident.

Each team has had exactly one player play. Each scored exactly 15.5. That's a 100% correlation between Kyren Williams and Christian Watson, two players who have never been in the same building wearing the same jersey. Analytics doesn't care about that, and neither do I.

Projecting forward: if each of the eight remaining starters per team scores exactly 15.5, both teams finish at 139.50, which is 1.13 above Kraft for Cash's season average and 8.59 below Catfan94’s Farm Team's. So my model has Kraft for Cash overachieving in a tie. That's a moral victory, which counts for zero in standings.

The sportsbook upstairs has Catfan94’s Farm Team by 10.0. My spreadsheet has it 139.50 to 139.50. One of us is going to be wrong on Tuesday, and I've already formatted the cell to say it was the sportsbook.

columns.title: ManicOrientals has one quarterback for a superflex elimination game. That's not bad luck. That's a plan that never happened.
columns.dek: Richard "Dick" Gozinya on Asian Jim, OBJAY, and the game where somebody's season ends Sunday.
body: Let me be clear about what's not anybody's fault. Kyler Murray being Out isn't ManicOrientals' fault. Nobody controls that. What I'm talking about is what happened next, and what didn't.

Daniel Jones got released by the Colts and his 4.06 counted in Week 11. Since then, Asian Jim has made one move: Dawson Knox for Tyler Goodson on Sunday morning. A tight end. In a league that starts two quarterbacks, the roster has Tyler Shough, Jack Strand on taxi listed Out, Murray, and an unsigned Jones. Meanwhile Jefferson’s Reserve has five quarterbacks and I Chase Brown Kids has six. Kirk Cousins is starting in Minnesota and sitting on jmello16's bench. Pick up the phone.

Now it's OBJAY vs Asian Jim, both teams averaging 116 points, and I've got JAY2913 as a touchdown favorite because he has Geno Smith and Bo Nix and ManicOrientals has Shough and a running back at superflex. That's the whole spread. When I played, if you showed up to the biggest game of the year with one helmet for two guys, the coach didn't call it bad luck. He called it Monday's film session.
JAY2913, don't get comfortable. You benched 122 receiving yards on Monday night. Antonio Williams plays this week too. Start him. Both of you toughen up.

columns.title: 6 Thanksgiving-week moves from Holden McGroin, who has already eaten the turkey and it's Tuesday
columns.dek: Holden McGroin's advice for Week 12. He has been told about the Wednesday game. He does not believe it.
body: 1. Bill_Buttlicker, leave Jacory Croskey-Merritt in the IR slot. He scored 16.7 there. If something works, you don't touch it. That's why I've had the same Sleeper password since 2017, which is 'password.'
2. ZachCarroll09, you lost by 10.38 with Rashod Bateman on the bench. The fix is obvious: bench Adonai Mitchell AND Bateman. Then neither one can hurt you. Defense wins championships.

3. Everybody, there's no game on Wednesday. Thanksgiving is Thursday. The NFL doesn't play on Wednesday, it's a known fact, I looked it up in my head. Set your lineup Sunday at 12:55 like a professional.
4. BTaylor1, Justin Herbert is Questionable, so start all three quarterbacks. Sleeper will stop you. Sleeper is a coward.

5. Br0phy, you're 0‑11 against a guy who can't find his own IR slot. Trade your whole roster to Bill_Buttlicker before the game for his worst players. Then you're starting his team against your old team, which is his team. I don't know who wins. Neither does anyone. That's the edge.
6. paknight12, Dak Prescott scored 44.9 and 45.42 and you lost both. Bench him. You'll score less, but you'll lose by less, and losing by less is basically winning, according to me.

exits.t: Ran for a career-high 184 yards on 32 carries Wednesday and scored 31.5 on the I Chase Brown Kids bench, after starting and scoring double digits for five straight games before the Rams' bye. Adonai Mitchell and Carnell Tate are starting over him.

Scored 11.1 the one week StrngeJhnsonHurtsmyBoutte started him, sat out the Rams' bye, and then scored 10.9 on the bench Wednesday while two Questionable receivers start. He'd like a manager who reads box scores.

Caught nine passes for 122 yards on Monday Night Football, 19.2 points, on the OBJAY bench while Emeka Egbuka (3.3) and Luther Burden III (2.8) started. OBJAY lost by 105.56. Would like a team that watches Monday night.
Scored 12.1 on the LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix bench in Week 11 while Isaiah Likely started at tight end and scored 5.0. Catfan94 won anyway, which is somehow worse. Would like to be needed somewhere.

Scored 12.4 on the Jefferson’s Reserve bench in Week 11 while Bhayshul Tuten (7.8) and Travis Etienne Jr. (8.1) started. Has noticed jmello16 hasn't spent $1 of FAAB all year and suspects the lineup gets the same attention.
In the Asian Jim starting lineup at flex, next to a superflex spot holding Daniel Jones, who has no NFL team. Mayer would like his points to go toward a lineup that has two quarterbacks with jobs.

facts: TJohn91 has won both titles on Sleeper. He went 12-2 in 2024 and 10-4 in 2025, and is 28-11 all time.
Bill_Buttlicker owns 12 first-round picks over the next three drafts, the most in the league. JAY2913 is next with six.
Catfan94's 243.58 in Week 5 this year is the highest score in league history, and his 232.54 in Week 10 is second. Nobody else has topped 198.64.
Bill_Buttlicker went 3-11 in 2024 and 4-10 in 2025, scored 54.86 in 2024 Week 3, the third-lowest score in league history, and is 10-29 all time.
Br0phy's 39.26 in Week 8 this year is the lowest score in league history by 14.78 points. Dude, Your Getting a Dell is 0-11.
